item.title: Tokyo Sims: The most unpredictable street interviews in Japan
item.description: Tokyo Sims brings together a collection of entertaining street interviews from Japan. From awkward conversations and surprising confessions to hilarious exchanges, this compilation captures the unpredictable nature of meeting strangers on the streets of Tokyo.
